name: Gravewake Lantern
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The gravewake lantern can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the gravewake lantern has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Lantern
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Mourning Glow
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 24 (7d6) Necrotic damage.
Actions.clause: When it hits a creature with Lantern, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {dmg} extra Necroti

lore: A lantern left burning at a deathbed, it drained the mourners' final grief and rose when they departed, forever carrying their sorrow and flaring whenever another life is extinguished near it.

generation.cite: composition after Specter (CR 1) — the drain touch on the incorporeal frame

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
